name: RC-B10-0066/2026 – Motion for a resolution
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Joseph Figueira Martin in the Central African Republic
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for the release of Joseph Figueira Martin, a Belgian-Portuguese humanitarian worker held in the Central African Republic. He was kidnapped in May 2024, tortured, held over a year without trial, then sentenced in November 2025 to 10 years of forced labour. Parliament wants him freed, given medical care, and sanctions on those responsible if he is not. This is a statement of demands, not a change in law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament demands his release, medical evacuation and possible sanctions.
- **Who it affects:** Mr Martin, the Central African Republic authorities, and the EU, Belgium and Portugal.
- **What happens next:** Parliament may send a mission; the EU may impose travel bans and asset freezes.
